title: PowerScope
protocol: Authored synthetic36days at5min; train first20days, validation next6days, test last10days; lag288 requires firstday warmup. One-step forecasts use known-now sensors and noisy planned-next-IT input, never measured future facility power. Fixed cooling-drift10day OOD independent seed.

split.embargo_note: training rows whose next-step target crosses boundary removed below

limits: All traces/scheduler forecasts/cooling/loss factors are authored simulation, no real ByteDance or external facility telemetry.
5min interval average power; cannot evaluate subsecond electrical transients.
Toy1200kW threshold not equipment rating, redundancy margin or breaker limit.
Interval from chronological validation residuals; autocorrelation violates exchangeability, no guaranteed90% coverage.
Same-window ratio not audited annual PUE; no measured energy saving.
Forecast only: no control commands, switchgear/cooling setpoints, UPS/protection coordination or safety approvals.
AI assisted research prototype; offline only and human review required.
